title: Concept: Archive extraction via tarfile.extractall (python) — review required
description: In python, tarfile.extractall writes archive members to the filesystem. Entry names are attacker-controlled metadata in hostile archives, so extraction without name checks is a write primitive. The remedy is per-entry validation via per-entry name validation.
applicability: python codebases extracting archives through tarfile.extractall; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file overwrite (Zip Slip) from hostile archives; HIGH severity because archives routinely cross trust boundaries.
